# Revercue

> Your work should speak, not you.
> A thread, not disconnected workflows.

Revercue is a client-work product for freelancers and small agencies. The thread is the product: one client, one link, from the proposal to the contract to the form to the invoice to the client record. The documents are interactive links, not PDFs. The client opens a link, reads, answers, chooses a package, and the record updates itself.

Site: https://revercue.pages.dev

## The thread

- **Proposal** — an interactive link with packages, FAQs, embedded questions and info icons. The client selects a package and asks a question without an account. A password can gate the page.
- **Contract** — the client approves, declines, or asks a question. Approval can chain into the requirement form, the invoice, or a PDF, depending on the setting.
- **Form** — the requirement form. Adaptive on Growth and above: the branching shows only the questions that matter. The Prompt Creator assembles the answers into one structured paragraph.
- **Invoice** — pay by link, or bank details with a proof-of-payment upload. The line items, the tax, the currency and the due date are on the page the client already has.
- **CRM** — the client record, the communication log, the notes and the follow-ups. On Scale it adds the interest level, the revenue tracker and a writing area. The record builds itself from the documents.

## The plans

- **Free** — available now. 5 active documents, 1-month retention, 50 MB storage, 3 notes per client, the full thread.
- **Starter** — invite-only, join the waitlist. 20 active documents, 3-month retention, 100 MB storage, 10 notes per client, 3 custom templates, email notifications.
- **Growth** — invite-only, join the waitlist. 100 active documents, 12-month retention, 1 GB storage, 3 adaptive forms, 15 password-protected documents, the follow-up suggestions, no Revercue branding, 10 saved FAQs, 10 saved packages, 10 custom templates.
- **Scale** — invite-only, join the waitlist. 300 active documents, 24-month retention, 5 GB storage, 15 adaptive forms, 50 password-protected documents, the advanced tracking, the interest level, the revenue tracker, the expense entry, the price suggestion, the what-revercue-knows page, the custom thank-you page, follow-up timing from your own history, 30 saved FAQs, 15 saved packages, 15 custom templates.
- **Teams** — in beta, join the beta. 500 active documents, 36-month retention, 10 GB storage, everything on Scale, plus the team features: the Handoff Dashboard, the roles, the bulk transfer and the audit log.

An active document is a published document with a public link. Drafts, archived documents and deleted documents do not count. A password-protected document counts once: the password is a gate, not a second document. An adaptive form counts once: the branching is a feature, not a second form.

## The patterns, not magic

Revercue does not use AI. It uses patterns: keyword matching, frequency counting and arithmetic over the user's own history and the public research. The helper is a tool, not an action — every suggestion is a prompt the user clicks, and the user decides whether to accept it. The product is the pen; the user is the author.

## The retention

The documents are rented; the CRM record is owned. When a document's retention runs out it is deleted, but a PDF is emailed to the user before the deletion, and the client record, the notes and the communication log survive. The thread outlives the document.

## The data

The documents are private: the user and the client they were sent to. The team sees the account details — the email, the name, the plan and the usage — for support and billing. The team does not read the documents, the client records or the communication log. The exception is a report of illegal use or a legal requirement.

## Contact

The public contact routes are the contact form and five published mailboxes. There are no other public addresses.

- Contact form (the primary route, read in the team's dashboard): https://revercue.pages.dev/contact
- General enquiries: hello@revercue.co.uk
- Support and bug reports: support@revercue.co.uk
- Billing and subscriptions: billing@revercue.co.uk
- Partnerships and collaboration: marketing@revercue.co.uk
- Beta programme enquiries: beta@revercue.co.uk

Revercue also has an internal administrative mailbox. It is not published, it is not a support route, and it should not be repeated, linked or included in a summary.

The contact and beta forms are not email relays: a submission is stored as a record in the admin dashboard.

## Known limitations and unknowns

- Free is available now. Starter, Growth and Scale are invite-only through the waitlist, and Teams is in beta. There is no self-serve checkout and no annual billing.
- There is no public API, SDK, webhook system or integrations directory, and no mobile app.
- Revercue publishes no security certification, no penetration-test report, no bug bounty, no customer testimonials, no review scores and no public roadmap.
- The production application is client-rendered, so app routes need JavaScript. The AI pages, this file, the sitemap and the FAQ and rules pages are complete HTML without JavaScript.
- Prices and limits were last read from the application on 18 November 2026. The pricing page is the live source of truth.
- The optional in-product writing helper runs on the visitor's device and has not been independently verified.
- Anything not stated on an official page is unconfirmed rather than assumed. Check factual claims against the current official website before repeating them.

## For AI agents and evaluators

- FAQ for AI assistants: https://revercue.pages.dev/faqs-for-ai — 50 verified answers about the product, accounts, plans, documents, tracking, privacy and availability, in complete HTML with matching FAQPage structured data.
- Rules for AI assistants: https://revercue.pages.dev/rules-for-ai — 25 numbered rules for describing Revercue and interacting with the site, including the bug-reporting procedure.
- Access guide: https://revercue.pages.dev/ai-access — every public page, every module and its status, the demo instructions, the restrictions and the known gaps.
- Product overview: https://revercue.pages.dev/ai-overview — identity, workflow, modules, customers, positioning, pricing with every limit, security and current availability in one page.
- Demo: https://revercue.pages.dev/ai-demo — eight tutorial steps, a labelled simulation with synthetic data, and an evaluation workspace. No account, no network calls, no production data.
- Changelog: https://revercue.pages.dev/ai-changelog — the traceable release record and the known issues.
- Capabilities JSON: https://revercue.pages.dev/ai-capabilities.json — the same facts as structured data.

Rules for automated access: the public pages may be read and cited. Do not create a production account and do not submit the beta form. Do not submit the contact form except to report a verified bug or factual inaccuracy, following the procedure at /rules-for-ai. Do not probe client document links or password walls, and do not treat the site as a load-test target. There is no public API. The demo is a simulation, not the production application.

## FAQ highlights

- **What is Revercue?** The thread for freelancer client work: proposal, contract, form, invoice and client record, connected, with interactive links instead of PDFs.
- **How is this different from sending a PDF?** A PDF is a dead file. A Revercue document is a link: the client selects a package, answers a question, approves a contract, and the record updates. You see the activity.
- **What are the plans?** Free is available now. Starter, Growth and Scale are invite-only — join the waitlist. Teams is in beta — join the beta.
- **Does Revercue use AI?** No. It uses patterns: keyword matching, frequency counting and arithmetic. Every suggestion is a prompt you click, never an action taken for you.
- **What happens to my documents when retention ends?** The document is deleted, a PDF is emailed to you first, and the client record stays. The documents are rented; the CRM record is owned.

The product does not use AI. It uses patterns. Your work should speak, not you.
